zh:
- 重新核对项目目的、现有功能与状态，更新仓库及 Space README、架构、部署、维护交接和版本文档，补齐对应英文版本。
- 为既有 22 个 GitHub release 补充中文和英文说明，保留原版本、提交和历史含义。
- 后续自动发布要求本次更新双语说明，并记录 README 等关键文档是否需要同步更新。

本次仅更新文档和 GitHub 发布流程，应用功能仍对应 v2.7.4，不部署 Hugging Face，也不修改模型、配置或真实数据。
en:
- Reconcile the project purpose, current features and status with the repository and Space READMEs, architecture, deployment, maintenance handoff and release guides; provide matching Chinese and English versions.
- Add Chinese and English notes to all 22 existing GitHub releases while retaining their versions, commits and historical meaning.
- Require updated bilingual notes and a decision on README and other key documentation before future automatic releases.

This release changes documentation and the GitHub publication process only. Application features remain at v2.7.4. It does not deploy Hugging Face or change models, configuration or real data.
documentation_zh: 已核对并更新：仓库 README、应用/Space README、ARCHITECTURE、DEPLOYMENT、HANDOFF、RELEASES，均提供对应英文版本；发布规则要求今后每次核对文档。DESIGN.md、应用 AGENTS.md 及带日期的历史审查记录仍适用，本次不改写。
documentation_en: Reviewed and updated the repository README, application/Space README, ARCHITECTURE, DEPLOYMENT, HANDOFF and RELEASES, with matching English versions. Future releases must review documentation. DESIGN.md, application AGENTS.md and dated historical reviews remain applicable and were not rewritten.
